articles.summary: The Iran war is sending stocks in the IBD-tracked Chemicals-Agricultural industry group higher as investors continue to digest the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, which plays a critical role in the global fertilizer market.  As the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, muzzling the flow of crude oil from Persian Gulf producers to the rest of the world, fertilizer stocks have spiked due to the Middle East's role as a key producing region of oil and gas derivative elements such as nitrogen, a critical ingredient in many agricultural chemicals.
